_comment: v0.23.x — JSON-driven military unit definitions. Each entry describes one combatant type. The garrison building (barracks/fort) picks which unit_id to spawn via the 'spawn_unit' field on its building entry; the WalkerManager looks the unit up in this registry and instantiates a Soldier with the unit's stats. Schema: hp/damage are integers; speed is the per-tick fraction of a tile (default Walker speed is 0.05); sight is Chebyshev tiles; patrol_radius is how far a unit wanders from its home; ranged=true uses an extended sight to attack from a distance (Bowmen); armoured=true halves incoming damage (Heavy Infantry / Heavy Cavalry); sprite is the filename under assets/textures/walkers/ — defaults to the unit_id when omitted.

scout.name: Scout Squadron
scout.description: Fast, lightly equipped pathfinders. Wide patrol radius, low HP. First to see a raid coming.

light_infantry.name: Light Infantry
light_infantry.description: The standard garrison soldier. Balanced HP and damage. Default barracks output.

heavy_infantry.name: Heavy Infantry Legionary
heavy_infantry.description: Heavily armoured legionary. Slow but tough — takes half damage from incoming hits.

heavy_cavalry.name: Heavy Cavalry
heavy_cavalry.description: Mounted shock unit. Fast and armoured, hits the hardest in melee. Expensive to recruit.

bowman.name: Bowman
bowman.description: Ranged unit. Can engage enemies at Chebyshev 2 (instead of 1) and lobs fire arrows at adjacent enemy-occupied buildings (v0.29). Trades HP for stand-off damage.

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.description: Heavy ranged siege engine. Long sight, slow movement, high per-shot damage. Built by the Military Manufacture.

barbarian_infantry.name: Barbarian Infantry
barbarian_infantry.description: Hostile melee raider. The standard barbarian-side unit spawned by edge raids.

trade_ship.name: Trade Ship
trade_ship.description: Naval trader. Ferries one good between a coastal dock and a map-edge trade exit, crediting the treasury per round trip. Sinkable by raiders (v0.38).

transport_ship.name: Troop Transport
transport_ship.description: Trireme troop transport. Carries up to 10 embarked legionaries across water and disembarks them onto the first land tile adjacent to its landing goal. The 'transport legions to land' mechanic (v0.38; 10-slot cap v0.46).

warship.name: Warship
warship.description: Ranged naval combatant. Engages enemy ships and coastal raiders at Chebyshev 2, screening trade and transport ships (v0.38).
